newsitem.title: USA: Parisian holders OK merger with Proffitt's.
newsitem.headline: Parisian holders OK merger with Proffitt's.

text.p: Proffitt's Inc said Monday that stockholders in Parisian Inc of Birmingham, Ala., have approved the merger of the two companies, scheduled to close in October.

As a condition of the merger, the companies were required to obtain consent from the holders of Parisian's 9-7/8 percent senior subordinated notes. Proffitt's said the necessary consents had been obtained.
In July, Proffitt's said it signed an agreement to buy Parisian, a regional specialty department store company, for $110 million in cash and about 2.9 million shares of Proffitt's common stock.
